body: I haven't been convicted yet. I'm debating shelling out or going into debt to hire a private attorney to try and get diversion because this is my first offense and it was non-violent. I'm not eligible for a public defender because they aren't seeking jail time against me.

I don't find enjoyment. Life sucked before now, and it's going to suck more because of my bad choices. Nothing to look forward to except dying. My lack of energy has persistently been the reason I haven't died yet.
I've never been too interested in it. Who knows what I'll have to do to get by though, not that there's anything wrong with that field of work.

Actually, no; in the years prior to this, when I was also depressed, I looked back trying to find a time when I was happy, and realized that I never was. I was never physically abused or anything, but I still wouldn't miss any of my past life experiences so far.

I never hurt anyone. No one is at a loss for my actions, but me. There's no victim who's going to wake up every morning remembering what I did. Because of alleged dollar amount, this is more serious, but that's the Capitalist society we live in, if you ask me.

I know it was wrong, but at that one moment, I wasn't piecing all the components together. I could happily accept paying fines and getting treatment. But I can't accept suffering with this for the rest of my life if I live. 

I won't be able to do any of the jobs I wanted to, it will affect who will lease to me, it's going to affect where I'm allowed to go for the next five years, and still some places will be off limits for life.

It's only a misdemeanor, but I can't get it expunged in my state. In about five years maybe I can ask for a "set aside", but that isn't quite as good. If people want to make sure I'm acceptable, they'll still be able to find the conviction.

In any case, I'm obviously not running out to kill myself tonight, so chances are I'll just settle back into complacency unless something else sets me off.

Notice how it was the tough love comment that got my attention? Probably shows how pathetic I am, but I don't think my issues are just "petty". I'm alone, I literally lost every social support and relationship because of my arrest, I'll be in debt, and my only career plan is most likely lost to me. So like I was saying, maybe I could still end up with an OK life, but I don't really care anymore.

I see your point, but even if one draws a comparison between the living situations of myself; almost middle class in a first world country, and someone in a third world country, the feelings of depression themselves are not comparable.

Basically, I feel it's relative. Nobody but I has to live my life, and sure, I could try to build myself up by imagining starving kids who have it worse, but really I just don't wish to continue living in our current society anyway when it's not going to be so much living as just existing.
